Field Notes
on the Strata


Whoever finds this: the ground remembers.

I found this chamber sealed. No door, no shaft. Whoever built it meant it to stay shut.

The gravel is disturbed. Brush it and it gives things up.

Seed Shards, mostly. Fragments of the world's own generation data.

Also a red gem nobody mines any more. A flower I don't recognise. A page of notes that isn't mine.

The frame at the centre is the point of all this.

Strike it with a Seed Shard and it opens.

I went through.

Same coordinates. Same seed. Not the same world.

The sky sits lower. The hills are stepped.

To come back, touch the frame with an empty hand. That much is free.

Going in costs a shard. Coming out never should.

Nothing grows there that I planted. Nothing rains. You cannot sleep.

It is your world. Just not the version you remember.
